posts.text: "I've been really impressed with the Vercel Agent Browser. I think for the first time I've actually found something that I'd say is great for an agentic browser automation tool."
posts.notes: Quote-post of a testimonial video praising agent-browser as the first agentic browser automation tool that actually works. Low engagement but useful signal of external validation.

posts.text: Introducing json-render: AI-generated UI with deterministic output. Define your component catalog, AI streams JSON, then render interactive UI. Let users prompt dashboards, widgets and apps—safely constrained to components and actions you define.
posts.notes: json-render launch post. Generative UI with deterministic output — AI streams JSON constrained to a pre-defined component catalog. 680K views, 6086 bookmarks. Major signal: mirrors our 70/30 deterministic/LLM split. Guardrailed generation via component whitelists.

posts.text:
Weekend project: agent-browser

Browser automation CLI for agents

→ Zero config
→ Fast Rust CLI
→ Headed or Headless
→ Up to 93% less context than Playwright MCP
→ Compatible with Codex, Claude Code, Gemini, Cursor, Copilot, opencode, and any agent that supports Bash
posts.notes: agent-browser launch post. 93% less context than Playwright MCP. Universal agent compatibility (Codex, Claude Code, Gemini, Cursor, Copilot, opencode). Rust CLI. 319K views, 1740 bookmarks. Definitive ingest candidate.
